类 PlayerInventoryEvent

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event

org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerInventoryEvent
@Deprecated public class PlayerInventoryEvent extends PlayerEvent
已过时。
Use InventoryClickEvent or InventoryOpenEvent instead, or one of the other inventory events in org.bukkit.event.inventory. 请改用 InventoryClickEvent 或 InventoryOpenEvent，或 org.bukkit.event.inventory 中的其他物品栏事件。
Represents a player related inventory event; note that this event never actually did anything 表示与玩家有关的物品栏事件；注意此事件实际上从未有过任何作用
